info.name: School Management API
info.description:
MoEYS Secondary School Management System — local API.

1. Select the **School Management – Local** environment and set `username` / `password`.
2. Run **Auth → Login** — the token is saved to `accessToken` and sent automatically by every other request.
3. If login returns `mustChangePassword: true`, set `newPassword` and run **Auth → Change password** first; every other route returns 403 until you do.

Create requests save the new id (`academicYearId`, `classSectionId`) for the Get/Update/Delete requests that follow. Running the whole collection creates a test academic year and class, then removes them in the **Delete** folder.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login, forced password change and current user.

request.description: Returns a JWT plus the user's roles and whether they have a staff/student profile. The token is saved to `accessToken`.

exec: if (data.mustChangePassword) console.warn('mustChangePassword is true — run Auth → Change password before anything else');

request.description: Current user with roles and effective permission codes. Returns 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED until the password is changed.

Set `newPassword` in the environment first. Policy: 8–72 chars with upper, lower, digit and symbol.

On success the new token is saved and `password` is updated to the new value. Tokens issued before the change stop working.

item.name: School Settings
item.description: One school per installation. Anyone signed in can read the settings; changing them needs `UPDATE_SCHOOL_SETTINGS` (System Admin only). The level decides which grades exist: LOWER_SECONDARY (7–9), UPPER_SECONDARY (10–12), COMBINED (7–12).

request.description: Level, grades offered, Khmer/Latin name, MoEYS code, address, phone.

body.raw:
{
  "khmerName": "វិទ្យាល័យ ព្រះស៊ីសុវត្ថិ",
  "latinName": "Preah Sisowath High School",
  "moeysCode": "PP-0001",
  "address": "Phnom Penh",
  "phone": "023 123 456"
}

request.description: Edit the body with your school details, then Send. Partial update: send only the fields you want to change; null or "" clears a field. khmerName must be Khmer script. Needs UPDATE_SCHOOL_SETTINGS (log in as admin — Principal gets 403).

Set level to LOWER_SECONDARY (grades 7–9), UPPER_SECONDARY (10–12) or COMBINED (7–12), then Send. Adds the new range's grades (with default MoEYS subjects) and removes grades outside it. Returns 409 LEVEL_CHANGE_BLOCKED while any grade being removed still has class sections — on demo data run `npm run db:reset:demo -- --confirm --clear` first, then `npm run db:seed:demo` after switching. Needs UPDATE_SCHOOL_SETTINGS (admin).

item.name: Grades
item.description: Permissions: `LIST_GRADES`, `VIEW_GRADE`, `CREATE_GRADE`, `UPDATE_GRADE`, `DELETE_GRADE`. Grades 7–12 are seeded; level is derived from the number.

request.description: Saves the first grade (Grade 7) as `gradeId` for the requests below.
gradeNumber must be 7–12. All six are seeded, so this returns 409 GRADE_EXISTS unless one was deleted.
Changing to a number that already exists returns 409 GRADE_EXISTS.

item.name: Subjects
item.description: Permissions: `LIST_SUBJECTS`, `VIEW_SUBJECT`, `CREATE_SUBJECT`, `UPDATE_SUBJECT` (also for assigning to grades), `DELETE_SUBJECT`. The 13 MoEYS default subjects are seeded once; after that, edits and grade assignments made here are never overwritten by the seed.

query.description: Only subjects taught in this grade

request.description: `code` (e.g. MATH) is upper-cased, unique and permanent — 409 SUBJECT_CODE_EXISTS if taken. khmerName must be Khmer script, latinName Latin letters. isCoreSubject defaults to true (failing it means failing the year). Saves `subjectId`.
Partial update of khmerName, latinName, isCoreSubject. code cannot be changed.
Adds the subject to one or more grades. Grades that already have it are reported in `alreadyAssigned` (not an error). 404 GRADE_NOT_FOUND for unknown ids.
Removes the subject from one grade. 404 NOT_ASSIGNED if it was not assigned.

item.name: Academic Years
item.description: Permissions: `LIST_ACADEMIC_YEARS`, `VIEW_ACADEMIC_YEAR`, `CREATE_ACADEMIC_YEAR`, `UPDATE_ACADEMIC_YEAR`, `DELETE_ACADEMIC_YEAR`. Only one year can be ACTIVE at a time.

request.description: name must be consecutive years ("2026-2027"); dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Saves `academicYearId`.
Partial update. Activating returns 409 ACTIVE_YEAR_EXISTS if another year is already ACTIVE. Setting COMPLETED locks its classes.

item.name: Class Sections
item.description: Permissions: `LIST_CLASS_SECTIONS`, `VIEW_CLASS_SECTION`, `CREATE_CLASS_SECTION`, `UPDATE_CLASS_SECTION`, `DELETE_CLASS_SECTION`. Classes in a COMPLETED year are locked.

request.description: Optional `homeroomTeacherId` (a staff profile id). Section names are upper-cased; duplicates per grade + year return 409 CLASS_SECTION_EXISTS. Saves `classSectionId`.
Partial update of sectionName, maxCapacity, homeroomTeacherId. Capacity cannot go below current enrollment. Grade and year cannot change.
A second class in the same grade and year, used by Enrollments → Transfer. Saves `classSectionId2`.

request.description: nationalIdNo (លេខអត្តសញ្ញាណប័ណ្ណ) is required and unique — set `nationalIdNo` in the environment to an ID not yet registered; Khmer digits and spaces are normalised (០១២ ៣៤៥ ៦៧៨ = 012345678). phone is normalised to local format (012345678); telegramHandle is stored with "@". hireDate cannot be in the future. Saves `staffId`.

request.description: Demonstrates duplicate prevention: the same national ID returns 409 DUPLICATE_STAFF naming the existing staff member.

query.description: Khmer name, Latin name, national ID, phone or Telegram handle

request.description: Use this to look up a staffId from a name before assigning a homeroom.
Partial update. Send null to clear phone or telegramHandle.

`classSectionId` is the homeroom class. `academicYear` is the year name (e.g. "2026-2027"); omit it to use the ACTIVE year. If the class already has a homeroom teacher they are replaced (`previousHomeroomTeacher` in the response). Errors: 409 TEACHER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED (one homeroom per teacher per year), 404 STAFF_NOT_FOUND / CLASS_SECTION_NOT_FOUND / ACADEMIC_YEAR_NOT_FOUND, 400 ACADEMIC_YEAR_MISMATCH, 409 ACADEMIC_YEAR_CLOSED.

item.name: Assign same teacher to a second class (expect 409)

request.description: Demonstrates the rule: a teacher can be homeroom teacher of only one class per academic year.

item.name: Students
item.description: Permissions: `LIST_STUDENTS`, `VIEW_STUDENT`, `CREATE_STUDENT`, `UPDATE_STUDENT`, `DELETE_STUDENT`. Students leave via status DROPPED_OUT / GRADUATED; delete is only for records entered by mistake.

body.raw:
{
  "birthCertificateNo": "{{birthCertificateNo}}",
  "khmerName": "សុខ ចាន់ថា",
  "latinName": "Sok Chantha",
  "dateOfBirth": "2013-04-14",
  "gender": "F",
  "primarySchoolOrigin": "Wat Phnom Primary School"
}

request.description: Set `birthCertificateNo` in the environment to a number not yet registered. birthCertificateNo (លេខសំបុត្រកំណើត) is required and unique — registering the same certificate again returns 409 DUPLICATE_STUDENT naming the existing student. Khmer digits are accepted (១២៣/២០១៣ = 123/2013). studentIdentifier (STU-YY-0001) is generated automatically. khmerName must be Khmer script, latinName Latin letters, gender M or F, age 8–30. Saves `studentId`.

query.description: Khmer name, Latin name, student ID or birth certificate number

request.description: Partial update. studentIdentifier cannot be changed.

item.name: Enrollments
item.description: Permissions: `LIST_ENROLLMENTS`, `VIEW_ENROLLMENT`, `CREATE_ENROLLMENT`, `UPDATE_ENROLLMENT`, `DELETE_ENROLLMENT`. Capacity is enforced under a row lock, so simultaneous requests can never overfill a class. Enrollments in a COMPLETED year are locked.

request.description: Creates a NEW_ADMISSION enrollment. Errors: 400 CLASS_CAPACITY_REACHED ("Class capacity reached."), 400 ACADEMIC_YEAR_MISMATCH, 409 ALREADY_ENROLLED (one class per year), 409 NOT_A_NEW_ADMISSION (student has earlier enrollments), 409 STUDENT_NOT_ACTIVE. Saves `enrollmentId`.
Class list sorted by Khmer name with seat usage (maxCapacity, enrolled, seatsLeft, female, male). Needs `VIEW_CLASS_SECTION` + `LIST_ENROLLMENTS`.
Moves the student to another class in the same academic year. The target class capacity is checked the same way as a new enrollment.
How a student leaves the school — keeps their record and enrollment history; their seat no longer counts toward capacity.

item.name: Users & Roles
item.description: Login accounts for staff and students. Permissions: `LIST_USERS`, `VIEW_USER`, `CREATE_USER`, `UPDATE_USER` (roles, suspend, reset password), `DELETE_USER`; roles: `LIST_ROLES`, `VIEW_ROLE`, `CREATE_ROLE`, `UPDATE_ROLE`, `DELETE_ROLE` (custom roles only; you can only grant permissions you hold). Every login belongs to exactly one staff OR student profile. New logins and password resets always set mustChangePassword: true.

request.description: Saves `teacherRoleId` and `registrarRoleId` for the requests below.
All permission codes grouped by module. Permissions are defined in code (each is enforced by a route), so custom roles are built from this list. Needs VIEW_ROLE.

body.raw:
{
  "khmerName": "មន្ត្រីប្រឡង",
  "latinName": "{{customRoleName}}",
  "permissionCodes": [
    "LIST_STUDENTS",
    "VIEW_STUDENT",
    "LIST_CLASS_SECTIONS",
    "VIEW_CLASS_SECTION",
    "LIST_ENROLLMENTS"
  ]
}

request.description: Needs CREATE_ROLE. latinName must be unique (case-insensitive) → 409 ROLE_NAME_EXISTS; unknown codes → 400 UNKNOWN_PERMISSION; you can only grant permissions you hold yourself → 403 CANNOT_GRANT_PERMISSION. Saves `customRoleId`.
Partial update of khmerName / latinName. System roles (System Admin, Principal, Registrar, Teacher, Student) return 409 SYSTEM_ROLE_IMMUTABLE.
Replaces the full permission set. Users holding the role get the new permissions on their next request. Custom roles only; same escalation rule as create.

Create Login for a staff profile. Exactly one of `staffId` / `studentId` is required (no orphan accounts, no shared logins). Staff need at least one role; the Student role is reserved for students. Optional `temporaryPassword`; when omitted one is generated and returned ONCE in the response (saved to `temporaryPassword`). mustChangePassword is always true. Saves `userId`.

item.name: Create second login for same staff (expect 409)

request.description: Demonstrates the 1:1 rule: a profile can have only one login → 409 PROFILE_HAS_LOGIN.
Student logins always get the Student role (roleIds may be omitted). Saves `studentUserId`.
Replaces the full role set. The last active System Admin cannot lose that role, and you cannot remove it from yourself.
Takes effect immediately: existing tokens get 401 and login returns 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED. You cannot suspend yourself or the last active System Admin.
Generates a new temporary password (or send `temporaryPassword`), sets mustChangePassword: true and revokes all existing tokens. The new password is returned once and saved to `temporaryPassword`.

item.name: Delete
item.description: Deletes run last so the requests above have data to work with. Records still in use return 409.

request.description: For enrollments made by mistake. Not allowed in a COMPLETED year.
Removes the login only; the student profile is kept. Must run before deleting the student (409 STUDENT_HAS_LOGIN otherwise).
Removes the login only; the staff profile is kept. You cannot delete your own login or the last active System Admin.
Mistaken entries only (System Admin / Principal). Returns 409 STUDENT_HAS_HISTORY if the student has enrollments — set status DROPPED_OUT instead.
Returns 409 CLASS_SECTION_IN_USE if students are enrolled.
Returns 409 STAFF_HAS_HOMEROOM while they are homeroom teacher of a class, or 409 STAFF_HAS_LOGIN if they have a login.
Returns 409 ACADEMIC_YEAR_IN_USE if it still has classes or enrollments.
Returns 409 SUBJECT_IN_USE while the subject is assigned to any grade — unassign it first.
Custom roles only. Returns 409 ROLE_IN_USE while assigned to any user.
⚠️ Removes a seeded grade and its subject links. Skipped unless you set `gradeIdToDelete`. Returns 409 GRADE_IN_USE if it has classes; re-run `npm run db:seed` to restore subject links.
